environments.label: Staging
environments.note: Staging is an intended separate integration environment. Its current reachability, data isolation, Redis, and broker configuration must be verified in the target environment.

environments.label: Production
environments.note: Production deployment and operational readiness are not verified by this documentation repository. Confirm deployment, credentials, backups and recovery evidence in the target environment.

environments.label: Sandbox
environments.note: There is no mocked sandbox. Staging runs the same reconciliation behaviour, which is what makes testing meaningful.
